scripts.clean: [ -d android ] && ./gradlew clean --project-dir android --no-daemon; rm -rf node_modules .expo android ios dist
scripts.build:apk: bun run prebuild:android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.build:apk:release: bun run prebuild:android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.build:apk:fast: [ -d android ] || bun run prebuild:android; cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease
